eps.ov: As U.A. students and teachers recover from the League of Villains attack on USJ, Izuku learns about why Ochaco wants to become a hero.
eps.oa: بينما يتعافى طلاب UA ومعلموها من هجوم «عصبة الأشرار» على «USJ»، يعرف «إيزوكو» لماذا تريد «أوتشاكو» أن تصير بطلة.

eps.ov: The U.A. sports festival begins and all eyes are on the first-years as they start their qualifying round—the obstacle course race.
eps.oa: يبدأ المهرجان الرياضي في UA، وكل الأنظار على طلاب السنة الأولى وهم يبدؤون جولتهم التأهيلية: سباق الحواجز.

eps.ov: The first years try to stand out as they struggle to finish the obstacle course and qualify for a spot in the next round.
eps.oa: يحاول طلاب السنة الأولى أن يتميزوا وهم يكافحون لإنهاء سباق الحواجز والتأهل إلى الجولة التالية.

eps.ov: Izuku’s having trouble finding a team for the cavalry battle in the next round of the U.A. sports festival. Luckily, he has a plan.
eps.oa: يجد «إيزوكو» صعوبة في تكوين فريق لـ«معركة الفرسان» في الجولة التالية من مهرجان UA الرياضي، لكن لحسن الحظ لديه خطة.

eps.ov: Fighting it out in the second half of the cavalry battle, does Team Midoriya have what it takes to stay in the top four?
eps.oa: في الشوط الثاني من «معركة الفرسان»، هل يملك «فريق ميدوريا» ما يلزم ليبقى بين الأربعة الأوائل؟

eps.ov: Izuku learns more about Todoroki’s past as the first-years head into the final round of the sports festival.
eps.ta: الفتى الذي وُلد ومعه كل شيء
eps.oa: يعرف «إيزوكو» المزيد عن ماضي «تودوروكي» بينما يمضي طلاب السنة الأولى إلى الجولة الأخيرة من المهرجان الرياضي.

eps.ov: Izuku is up against Shinso in the first match of the finals, but can he overcome Shinso’s Quirk to advance to the next round?
eps.oa: يواجه «إيزوكو» «شينسو» في أول مباريات النهائيات، فهل يتغلب على ميزة شينسو ليتأهل إلى الجولة التالية؟

eps.ov: It’s one match after another in the first round of the finals tournament. Who will advance to second round?
eps.oa: تتوالى المباريات في الجولة الأولى من بطولة النهائيات. فمن يتأهل إلى الجولة الثانية؟

eps.ov: Bakugo seems almost villainous when he’s up against Uraraka, but she has a plan to keep it from being a one-sided match.
eps.oa: يبدو «باكوغو» أشبه بالأشرار وهو يواجه «أوراراكا»، لكن لديها خطة تمنع المباراة من أن تكون من طرف واحد.

eps.ov: Izuku forces Todoroki to face his past in a chilling battle as the two class rivals finally go head to head!
eps.oa: يرغم «إيزوكو» «تودوروكي» على مواجهة ماضيه في معركة تقشعر لها الأبدان، إذ يتواجه الغريمان في الصف أخيراً وجهاً لوجه!

eps.ov: It’s class rep versus child prodigy as Iida and Todoroki square off. Will Iida’s Reciproburst be enough to beat the boy of fire and ice?
eps.oa: إنه مندوب الصف ضد الطفل النابغة، إذ يتواجه «إيدا» و«تودوروكي». فهل تكفي «ريسيبرو بيرست» لدى إيدا لهزيمة فتى النار والجليد؟

eps.ov: The explosive showdown between Todoroki and Bakugo begins. Only one can take the title of first-year champion!
eps.oa: تبدأ المواجهة المتفجرة بين «تودوروكي» و«باكوغو»، ولا يقدر إلا أحدهما على نيل لقب بطل السنة الأولى!

eps.ov: Following their epic debut at the sports festival, it’s time for the first-years to pick the most important part of their identities—their hero name!
The internships begin! While everyone adjusts to their new tasks, Izuku starts training with Gran Torino, the same man who once taught All Might.
The U.A. students are finally starting to get the hang of their internships, but Izuku has much more to learn about One For All.

eps.t: Hero Killer: Stain vs U.A. Students
eps.ov: Stain strikes again, and this time some U.A. students are around when it happens. Will they be able to hold him off until the pros come?
It all comes to a head as Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki face off against Stain while the pro heroes in Hosu City fight against the Nomus.

eps.t: The Aftermath of Hero Killer: Stain
eps.ov: Stain is finally captured, but while the hero community deals with the consequences, an even greater challenge is set in motion.
As Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki recover from their fight with Stain, the other members of Class 1-A work hard at their own internships.

eps.t: Listen Up!! A Tale from the Past
eps.ov: The students return to their daily lives while All Might has a special history lesson for Izuku. It’s time to learn about One For All!
Finals are coming up and Class 1-A is going to need more than a cram session. This year, the teachers are changing the practical exams.
The exams are turning out to be much more challenging than the students expected. Can any of the teams hold their own against a teacher?
As the students of Class 1-A fight in their practical exams, their resolve to become heroes is put to the test.
It’s finally time for Izuku and Bakugo’s practical exam. How can they challenge All Might without a plan?
Class 1-A goes shopping for training camp supplies, but things get out of hand when a villain pulls Izuku aside.
